ledger.x: 300 BCE: the Donghu are the neighbours of Yan.
300 BCE: Yan's frontier advances against the Donghu.

wars.name: Qin Kai's campaign against the Donghu
wars.outcome: Qin Kai, a Yan general who had been a hostage among the Donghu, defeated them in 300 BCE; the page gives no distance and no land transferred; the zone is the Yan growth of 291 that the yan dossier takes from the Donghu (researcher's reading).

wars.name: Xiongnu conquest of the Donghu
wars.outcome: After the Donghu king asked for Modu's best horses and a consort, Modu attacked; by 208 BCE the Donghu were defeated and split into the Xianbei and the Wuhuan.

certainty.note: A steppe people of the Yan frontier: the page names mountain ranges and provinces, never a border.
